newsitem.title: UK: Straight-run fuel - low sulphur up on Friday crude.
newsitem.headline: Straight-run fuel - low sulphur up on Friday crude.

text.p: Straight run fuel oil prices were higher on Monday taking a lead from crude's rise on Friday, but activity was lacklustre.
"Theorectically prices are stronger, but there's little interest from sellers or buyers," said one trader.
Sellers said that even at $145 fob NWE prices were not attractive enough to sell unless under pressure.
Crude margins have weakened only marginally and no fresh impetus to buy was seen although U.S. interest lurks in the background. E-4's were pegged around formula +$2.50, little changed from Friday.
